$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFEJ (AIP France, chart dated 2026-01-22): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Châteauroux - Villers

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: ATS: NIL. The chart header prints these units to call, which are not services of this aerodrome (its air-air frequency apart): .
WDI: possible wrong indications when SE wind.
Pilots' attention is drawn towards the implementation of IFR and training procedures for wide bodied aircraft in the vicinity of CHATEAUROUX-DEOLS.
Lack of visibility between the two THR, extreme caution is required.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Instructions when the CTR CHATEAUROUX is activated: Aerodrome-circuits: regarding Villers circuits, squawk 7057 and contact CHATEAUROUX TWR as soon as possible.
Inform systematically CHATEAUROUX TWR at the end of session.; Arrivals: before entering CTR, get imperatively a clearance from CHATEAUROUX TWR.

To join Villiers aerodrome circuit, proceed to a Villers overhead at 1500 ft without overshooting east from Villers runway centerline.; Departures: contact CHATEAUROUX TWR as soon as possible to get a clearance.
As long as a radio contact has not been established, keep west from Villers runway centerline at 1500 ft QNR maximum waiting for clearance getting; possible exit to the west at 1500 ft.
Others sectors: compulsory clearance of CHATEAUROUX TWR.
